claude-opus-5-5.note: The pastel altiplano scene is soft and tasteful with gentle parallax, but the alpaca is anatomically broken: its scalloped neck floats detached above a cloud-blob body, and its stick legs shift between frames in an awkward, unconvincing gait.

openai-gpt-6-sol.note: The pastel landscape is polished and the legs change position, but the detached-looking neck and stiff, sliding gait weaken the alpaca and its walk.
